entities.summary: Sergio Chiamparino is an Italian politician. He was mayor of Turin from 2001 to 2011, and president of Piedmont from 2014 to 2019. He is also the author of several books, including Semplicemente sindaco, La sfida. Oltre il Pd per tornare a vincere. Anche al Nord (2010), Cordata con sindaco, and TAV. Perché sì.
